MOZ.note: Banco de Moçambique is cited only as source of inclusion statistics; no mandate, licensing, switch or regional role stated.
Nothing on consumer-protection rules or redress.

Figures are accounts per 100 adults from central bank provider data, not a survey share of adults.

facts.fact: Mozambique has three electronic money operators, M-Pesa, e-Mola and M-Kesh, providing financial services by mobile phone, with 130.9 e-money accounts per 100 adults in Q2 2026, according to Banco de Moçambique data compiled by Lusa.

MOZ.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
